UBS Expects The Fed To Hike In September & December, Vs. Unchanged Previously

UBS has changed its Fed rate call. Chief US economist Jonathan Pingle expects the Fed to raise rates on Sept. 16 by 25bp to a range of 3.75-4.00%, and then to raise again on Dec. 9 to 4.00-4.25%.
